name: John Fichthorn
current_role: Co-Founder & Managing Partner, Dialectic Capital Management (Norwalk, CT); Director, Quantum Corp (QMCO) since April 2025
profile: Investment manager with 25+ years as a public-equities analyst and activist investor; co-founded Dialectic Capital Management in 2003 and relaunched it in May 2020. In April 2025 Dialectic bought all $51M of Quantum's term debt from Blue Torch and Fichthorn rejoined Quantum's board (he previously served 2019-2021).
interesting_fact: Dialectic became Quantum's strategic lender by buying its entire $51M term loan; Fichthorn said 'providing capital to solve balance sheet constraints can unlock growth' and that Quantum had revamped its portfolio 'to address every stage of the data lifecycle'.
deep_cut_fact: This is his second stint on Quantum's board: he first served as a director from April 2019 to July 2021, before returning in April 2025 alongside the Dialectic debt purchase.
notes: Low public profile; little personal bio published. Don't confuse with Dialectic (Zug crypto firm of Ryan Zurrer). Best route is via Dialectic Capital's website; Quantum IR is a fallback for the director role. Quantum is a data-storage company (relevant to data-center angle).

name: Rishabh H Mariwala
current_role: Founder & Managing Partner, Sharrp Ventures (Mariwala family investment office); Non-Executive Director, Marico Ltd
profile: Son of Marico founder Harsh Mariwala. Worked at Marico's Kaya skin clinics (2007-10), then left to build his own soap brand before founding Sharrp Ventures (c.2014-15), the family's consumer-focused investment office. Early backer of Nykaa and Honasa (Mamaearth); the office has invested in ~40 companies and 18 funds.
interesting_fact: Sharrp Ventures was an early investor in both Nykaa and Honasa Consumer (Mamaearth), two of India's best-known consumer IPOs; he says the firm runs on 'long-term patient capital'.
deep_cut_fact: His entrepreneurial start was selling soaps out of a small shed in Sewri, Mumbai, building on his mother's soap-making hobby; he later launched the brand Pure Scents (2015) and sold it in 2020 to focus on investing. He has said of Marico: 'I sensed the organisation's culture, and I realised I did not fit in.'
notes: Accessible, podcast-friendly investor (has appeared on Dezerv and LetsVenture podcasts). Focus is consumer brands, not energy/data centers. Best route: Sharrp Ventures contact email.

name: Nathan Eric Fier
current_role: Non-Executive Chairman, Mako Mining Corp; Director, Coeur Mining (appointed Feb 2025; one profile lists the seat as ending Feb 2026, unconfirmed)
profile: Known as N. Eric Fier, CPG, P.Eng., a geological and mining engineer with 30+ years' experience. Co-founded SilverCrest Mines (sold to First Majestic in 2015), then founded SilverCrest Metals, which discovered and built the high-grade Las Chispas silver-gold mine in Sonora, Mexico; Coeur acquired SilverCrest in Feb 2025, giving him a Coeur board seat.
interesting_fact: SilverCrest was the first company to drill-test the historic Las Chispas district, which Fier says had never been drilled before; drilling began in 2016 and it became a major northern-Mexico discovery and mine.
deep_cut_fact: Before founding the SilverCrest companies he worked as Chief Geologist with Pegasus Gold Corp., Senior Engineer & Manager with Newmont Mining and Project Manager with Eldorado Gold; he holds both US (Certified Professional Geologist) and Canadian (P.Eng.) credentials.
notes: SEC name 'Nathan Eric Fier' = N. Eric Fier. Frequent mining-podcast/conference guest (VoiceAmerica, Stansberry), so likely open to interviews. Best route: Mako Mining general inbox.

name: Viorel Cataramă
current_role: Chairman of the Board and majority shareholder (~66%), Elvila SA (furniture maker, Bucharest Stock Exchange: ELV)
profile: Romanian businessman and politician, born 1955 in Bacău. Founded furniture manufacturer Elvila in 1990, one of Romania's first post-communist private businesses. Served as a secretary of state for trade (1990-91), PNL vice-president and senator for Bacău (1996-2000); ran for president in 2019 for his Liberal Right Party and rejoined the PNL in 2024.
interesting_fact: He ran in Romania's 2019 presidential election as the candidate of the Liberal Right Party he founded, finishing 9th; as a senator (1996-2000) he chaired the Senate's Economic Commission.
deep_cut_fact: A patron of music: in 2000 he organised a José Carreras concert in Bucharest, and since 2007 he has organised an annual Christmas concert with the Bucharest National Opera; in 1995 he also created cash prizes for students of his old high school who win national olympiads.
notes: Controversial 1990s-era figure in Romanian press (avoid). Elvila is small and loss-making now; no energy/data-center link. No published direct email found; route via Elvila (BVB filings list company contacts).
